## 4. AI Agents in Public Services

The roundup mentioned AI agents being highlighted by NVIDIA. ## What this means for you

- **For everyone**: This was a "follow the headlines" week, not a "do something today" week. The honest move is to bookmark the official pages for the products you care about and check back when full details land.
- **For Workspace users**: If Gmail AI matters to you, watch Google's Workspace updates blog. The features are coming, but our source didn't pin a date this week.

The pattern this week is the same one we've been tracking: AI is moving from demos into everyday systems — your inbox, your bank, your kids' classroom. Our source this week carried only the headlines, so treat today's news as a roadmap of what to follow up on.
